schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Group all internal easy-web packages - manual review required (published on public npm from github.com/achimismaili/easy-web). Two npm scopes are in use: the Azure DevOps instances consume @easy-web/*, the GitHub-hosted portfolio consumes @achimismaili/easy-web-*. Both must be listed or the group silently never matches.
Automerge external devDep patches only (conservative policy)
Paraglide: never automerge (codegen tool, output changes silently)
Major updates require manual review - one PR per package
